name: Data Analyzer: Live AI model reads a simple CSV data dictionary and finds fields
objective: Optional live check that the real AI model can parse a small dictionary file into field definitions.
precondition: Skipped unless the environment variable RUN_LIVE_LLM_TESTS=1 is set. When run, it needs network access, valid Azure OpenAI sign-in and a live AI model, so it is not part of the offline suite.

steps.action: Send the made-up simple CSV dictionary file to the live AI parser
steps.expected: Result contains a 'fields' entry with at least one field (field contents are not checked)

name: Data Analyzer: Live AI model reads the first pages of a PDF dictionary and finds fields
objective: Optional live check that the real AI model can parse text taken from a PDF dictionary.
precondition: Skipped unless the environment variable RUN_LIVE_LLM_TESTS=1 is set. When run, it needs network access, valid Azure OpenAI sign-in and a live AI model, so it is not part of the offline suite. The sample PDF and the PDF reading library must be present, otherwise the test is skipped.

steps.action: Extract text of the first 3 pages of the sample PDF, then send it to the live AI parser
steps.expected: Result contains a 'fields' entry with at least one field

name: Data Analyzer: Live AI model flags problems in a small deliberately flawed data sample
objective: Optional live check that the real AI model reports issues for data that breaks its rules.
precondition: Skipped unless the environment variable RUN_LIVE_LLM_TESTS=1 is set. When run, it needs network access, valid Azure OpenAI sign-in and a live AI model, so it is not part of the offline suite.

steps.action: Ask the live AI to validate made-up employee rows against a rule set
steps.data: 4 rows with planted problems (age 150, a blank last name, a minor aged 17, an unlisted department) and rules for ID, age, salary and department
steps.expected: Result contains 'issues' or 'summary', and the issues list has at least one entry (which issues are not checked)
